text:
sarah: Quick sync — HealthTech prospect (MedicaX) wants a 6-week POC. Need to align scope + deployment mode. Main asks: EU data residency, HIPAA posture, 200 prompt evals, <250ms p95 latency for generation, 10 rps sustained. Any blockers?

miguel: I had a call with their engineering lead. Hosted is fine for a prototype, but security asks push toward Dedicated or Private for anything that touches PHI. They asked about pricing and whether we can do a short committed pilot (3 months).

ranjit: Quick tradeoffs: Hosted (eu) = fastest to start, limited control over KMS unless we enable customer-managed keys; Dedicated = reserved GPU pools inside an EU region, faster rollout than Private; Private (VPC / on-prem) = full control + data residency guarantees but adds install time and license terms. If they require no cross-border traffic, lean Private.

mary_corpsec: Please confirm: SOC2 is available? We also need a filled security questionnaire, KMS rotation policy, and how audit logs are exposed. HIPAA/BAA is critical for legal to sign off.

miguel: Pricing note: Dedicated usually requires a monthly commit (we can provide tiers). For POC we can offer a reduced short-term commit or Hosted trial with stricter logging/KMS constraints. I'll follow up with concrete numbers in a doc.

ranjit: Proposed success criteria (draft):
```
- 200 labeled prompt/eval pairs covering functional + safety edge cases
- p95 latency <= 250ms for 512-token generation
- sustained throughput >= 10 rps for a 30-minute window
- intent classification F1 >= 0.92; hallucination incidents < 3%
- no PII leakage in any output during evals
```
Also need the sample prompts and expected outputs from their SME by EOD Friday so we can pre-run local sims.

sarah: Timeline (sketch): week0 kickoff, week1 prompt set + security review, week2 deploy sandbox (hosted or dedicated in eu), week3 run evals, week4 tune + canary, week5 stakeholder review, week6 decision. Feasible? :calendar:

mary_corpsec: On SCQ: requirement list — encrypted at rest (customer KMS preferred), audit logs retained 12 months, role-based access control, and a recent pentest/risk assessment. We will only provide de-identified PHI for the POC; any PHI requires a signed BAA.

miguel: deploy-bot: created INF-4821 (POC MedicaX checklist) with items: SCQ, SOC2, DPA/BAA, pricing options, infra ETA. I'll attach docs. @ranjit can you confirm Private install ETA if chosen?

ranjit: If Private chosen: estimate 3 weeks infra + 1 week validation = ~4 weeks before we can run full evals. Dedicated (eu-west-1) provisioning: ~1 week + 2-3 days validation. Hosted in eu: immediate provisioning. So to hit a 6-week overall POC, Private is tight but doable if we parallelize security review + infra prep.

mary_corpsec: Also need confirmation on log access scope (read-only exports to our SIEM), and proof of encryption key handling (no model training on customer data).

sarah: Next steps: miguel to send 2 pricing options (Hosted trial vs Dedicated 3-month pilot) + draft SOW; ranjit to document infra choices, region latency estimates, and Private install ETA; miguel to attach SCQ answers + SOC2 report + BAA template. I'll schedule a 15-min kickoff Tue. Thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: INF-4821 updated: initial checklist posted, assignees: miguel, ranjit, sarah.
